desc: Preview skins, wings and exclusive sets locally with our Unlock All Costume Changer module.

body.text: Costume Changer on [Elite](/products/aion-2-cheats/elite/) and the standalone [Unlock All product](/products/aion-2-cheats/unlock-all/) let you preview outfits, appearances, and exclusive sets locally in Aion 2.
Costume Changer overview

Costume Changer on [Elite](/products/aion-2-cheats/elite/) and the standalone [Unlock All product](/products/aion-2-cheats/unlock-all/) let you preview outfits, appearances, and exclusive sets locally in Aion 2.
Effects are client-side—lobby teammates see your real inventory; you see the cosmetic swap on your screen.
Unlock All vs Elite Costume Changer
Unlock All is cosmetic-only—browse, favorite, export loadouts. Elite bundles Costume Changer with aimbot, ESP wallhack, and bots.
Pick Unlock All if you only want visuals; pick Elite if you Abyss with full automation. Feature overview: [cheats features guide](/blog/aion-2-cheats-features-guide/).
Browse and preview workflow
Open the Costume Changer tab in your portal, search player name, select outfit or exclusive set, apply to local client. Use effect customizer for particle intensity.
Save favorites per player for quick swap before demo sessions or content recording. Loadouts export for backup across PCs via cloud sync on Elite.
Stream and content notes
Local skins appear on your display—stream capture may still show them depending on setup. Enable [stream-proof mode](/blog/aion-2-stream-proof-setup/) for ESP and script overlays.
Test cosmetic capture separately in a 30-second OBS clip before long streams. Radar hack camera does not affect skin particles.
anti-cheat and safety
Cosmetic modules carry the same third-party risk as any aion 2 cheat—read aion2cheats.net status before use. Unlock All does not grant costume wardrobe items; it only changes local preview.
No marketplace or trade impact—cosmetics are visual-only on your client. Pair with [anti-cheat checklist](/blog/anticheat-patch-day-checklist/) after patches.
Abyss with cosmetics
Elite operators run Costume Changer alongside aimbot—cosmetic tab separate from Abyss preset. Do not swap skins mid-fight; apply in fountain or strategy screen.
Compare [Elite tier guide](/blog/aion-2-elite-tier-guide/) if buying Elite primarily for Costume Changer plus bots.

Purchase [Unlock All](/products/aion-2-cheats/unlock-all/) or [Elite](/products/aion-2-cheats/elite/) through secure checkout at aion2cheats.net.
